title: Clubhouse Games: 51 Worldwide Classics
summary: Clubhouse Games: 51 Worldwide Classics is Nintendo's 2020 collection of board, card and table games, and on Switch 2 it gets a free update rather than a paid upgrade pack. The update's main addition is GameShare: according to Nintendo, up to four people can play 34 of the 51 games from one copy, either on nearby consoles or online through GameChat, which needs a paid Nintendo Switch Online membership. That makes it one of the cheapest ways to get a group playing together on Switch 2. The install is just 2.5 GB, and the Switch 1 cartridge holds the full game and works in a Switch 2.
